title: Post-translational modification learning signature highlights B4GALT2 in LUAD
summary: A post-translational modification learning signature (PTMLS) built with machine learning on 1231 lung adenocarcinoma patients from seven cohorts predicted outcome, surpassing 98 existing prognostic indicators, and immunotherapy response in 12 cohorts (n=1201). B4GALT2 was identified as a hub molecule, validated in an in-house cohort (n=171) and shown in vivo and in vitro to regulate immune exclusion. The machine learning signature is one of several tools in a bioinformatics-heavy study.
